feast.note: The day page for 2 января ст. ст. names him; his life pages head «Дни памяти: 2 января, 28 сентября (Печер.(Б))» and add the second Sunday of Great Lent, which are the synaxes of the fathers in the Near Caves and not a second proper feast, so neither is recorded as his day.
